verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages list exits, including IPOs and M&A, among its startup services, and its llms.txt describes sell-side and buy-side Venture M&A counsel for venture-backed companies (earnouts, escrows, holder consents). M&A is reasonably documented, but IPO capability is only a one-line service mention, so the full exit story is not covered. missing for 10: a dedicated IPO/public-offering practice page with representative venture-backed IPO deals, a dedicated exit/M&A page with named transactions or deal volume, and independent corroboration of exit track record.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages
